plugins.name: GIS Georgia Hub
plugins.summary: One place in QGIS to browse, install and update the GIS GEORGIA plugins (catalog in Georgian and English).

description.en: The catalog of the GIS GEORGIA plugins inside QGIS: search, read what each plugin does and where to find it, open its Processing algorithms, and install, update or remove it with a click. Checksum-verified downloads; update notice at start-up.
description.ka: GIS GEORGIA-ს დანამატების კატალოგი QGIS-ში: მოძებნე, ნახე რას აკეთებს თითოეული და სად მოიძებნება, გახსენი მისი Processing-ის ალგორითმები და დააყენე, განაახლე ან წაშალე ერთი დაჭერით. ჩამოწერა ჰეშის შემოწმებით; განახლებაზე შეტყობინება QGIS-ის გაშვებისას.

plugins.author: GIS GEORGIA | Giorgi Kapanadze

changelog.text: The catalog is signed (Ed25519): the Hub refuses a catalog that is unsigned, altered or signed by an unknown key, also when reading its offline copy. Processing algorithms for automation: Install / update / uninstall a GIS GEORGIA plugin, Update all GIS GEORGIA plugins, List the catalog (Toolbox, Model Builder, qgis_process, Python).
Update all, plugin icons, a note when a newer Hub exists, status line fixes.

First release: catalog window (search, filters, ka/en), install / update / uninstall / enable with checksum verification, Processing algorithms opened from the list, update notice at start-up, optional registration of the GIS GEORGIA repository in the Plugin Manager.

usage.en: Plugins menu (GIS Georgia) and the toolbar button.
usage.ka: მენიუ „დანამატები“ (GIS Georgia) და ხელსაწყოთა პანელის ღილაკი.

requires.en: Internet access to load the catalog and download plugins.
requires.ka: ინტერნეტი კატალოგის ჩასატვირთად და დანამატების ჩამოსაწერად.

plugins.name: QGIS Environment Manager
plugins.summary: What this QGIS is, which of your plugins declare support for QGIS 4, and what the GIS GEORGIA plugins need from the system (Georgian and English).

description.en: What this QGIS is and how it was installed, which of your plugins declare support for QGIS 4, and what the GIS GEORGIA plugins need from the system (PostgreSQL client tools, ExifTool, SAGA, GRASS) - with a reviewed one-step install on Linux. Copyable report for support.
description.ka: რა QGIS გაქვთ და როგორ არის დაყენებული; თქვენი დანამატებიდან რომელი აცხადებს QGIS 4-ის მხარდაჭერას; რა სჭირდება GIS GEORGIA-ს დანამატებს სისტემიდან (PostgreSQL-ის კლიენტი, ExifTool, SAGA, GRASS). Linux-ზე რაც აკლია, იმის დაყენება ბრძანებების გადახედვის შემდეგ. ანგარიში მხარდაჭერისთვის კოპირდება.

plugins.author: GIS GEORGIA | Giorgi Kapanadze

changelog.text: Safety: the package manager is asked what each plan would do before the question; automatic profile copy before QGIS is changed in place (nothing is changed if it cannot be made); copies listed and restorable as a new profile; other versions and back to older ones; keep a version (hold). / 0.4.0 - QGIS versions tab: a table of every installed QGIS with its version, a read-only update check (unknown is never shown as up to date) and starting a chosen one after reviewing the command; Flatpak removal now names the branch. / 0.3.0 - New tab "Components": GDAL, PROJ, GRASS, SAGA, Python libraries and database clients with the system package manager (install only; nothing is removed because a library can be a dependency of QGIS). / 0.2.0 - New tab "QGIS versions": update what is installed (apt, Flatpak, Snap, dnf, zypper, rpm-ostree; Arch gets the full-system line to run yourself), install another version from a recommendation for your goal (stable and long-term / newest / next to my QGIS) with the Flatpak branch and scope choice, instructions-only recipes for NixOS and Slackware, and a profile backup. Shared core updated to the new install recipes. / 0.1.0 - First release: diagnostics with a copyable report, a table of what each installed plugin declares for QGIS 3 and QGIS 4, and the system requirements of the GIS GEORGIA plugins with a reviewed one-step install on Linux.

usage.en: Plugins menu (QGIS Environment Manager) and the toolbar button.
usage.ka: მენიუ „დანამატები“ (QGIS Environment Manager) და ხელსაწყოთა პანელის ღილაკი.

requires.en: Diagnostics and the plugin table work on every system; installing system packages works on Linux with a system (not Flatpak or Snap) QGIS.

plugins.name: Plugin Downloader
plugins.summary: Download all QGIS plugins into one folder, with progress and pause/resume.

description.en: Download every QGIS plugin into one folder from the official repository — with overall and per-file progress and pause / resume / stop. Runs as a QGIS plugin and as a standalone PyQt app. Bilingual EN/KA.
description.ka: ჩამოწერე ყველა QGIS დანამატი ერთ საქაღალდეში ოფიციალური რეპოზიტორიიდან — საერთო და თითო ფაილის პროგრესით და pause / resume / stop-ით. მუშაობს QGIS დანამატადაც და ცალკე PyQt პროგრამადაც. ორენოვანი EN/KA.

plugins.author: GIS GEORGIA | Giorgi Kapanadze

changelog.text: Contact e-mail is now aigroegsig@gmail.com.

Georgian UI now says "დანამატი" instead of "ფლაგინი". The toolbar button and menu entry were hardcoded in Georgian and ignored the language setting; they and the dialog title now go through the translation table, so an English UI stays English.

Inside QGIS, Qt now comes from qgis.PyQt rather than importing PyQt6/PyQt5 directly, so the plugin always uses exactly the Qt that QGIS itself was built against. Standalone use is unchanged (PyQt6, falling back to PyQt5).

usage.en: Plugins menu and the toolbar button.

plugins.name: Transliterate Data
plugins.summary: Batch-transliterate Georgian names to clean Latin across a folder: shapefiles (+sidecars), database files (gpkg/sqlite/gdb), and inside them layers/feature classes and field names. Non-letter symbols become "_". Preview first, then apply in place or on a copy.

description.en: Batch-transliterate Georgian names to clean Latin across a folder: shapefiles (+sidecars), database files (gpkg/sqlite/gdb), and inside them layers/feature classes and field names. Non-letter symbols become “_”. Preview first, then apply in place or on a copy.
description.ka: ქართული სახელების მასობრივი ტრანსლიტერაცია სუფთა ლათინურზე მთელ საქაღალდეში: shapefile-ები (+sidecar), ბაზის ფაილები (gpkg/sqlite/gdb) და მათ შიგნით შრეები/feature class-ები და ველები. სხვა სიმბოლოები → „_“. ჯერ გადახედვა, მერე ადგილზე ან ასლზე.

plugins.author: GIS GEORGIA | Giorgi Kapanadze

changelog.text: Contact e-mail is now aigroegsig@gmail.com.
Processing algorithm "Transliterate data folder" (Toolbox, Model Builder, qgis_process, Python): preview, copy or in-place rename.
Wording only: "პლაგინი" is now "დანამატი" in the bundled README.

Runs on QGIS 4 (Qt6) and QGIS 3.40+ (Qt5) from the same build: scoped Qt enums, exec() instead of exec_(), QMetaType instead of QVariant field types, and Qt imported through qgis.PyQt. Minimum QGIS is now 3.40 LTR.

First release. Directory scan; shapefiles (+sidecars), gpkg/sqlite/gdb files, and their layers/feature classes and field names; Georgian national transliteration with symbol→"_" and collision handling; preview table; in-place or copy mode; bilingual ka/en.

plugins.name: Selection Tools

description.en: ArcGIS Pro-style “Selection” submenu on the layer context menu. Star tool: Make Layer From Selected Features — a new layer on the SAME source (no file written), saved with the project. Robust across GeoPackage, PostGIS, Shapefile and FileGDB.
description.ka: ArcGIS Pro-ს „Selection“ ქვემენიუს ანალოგი შრის მარჯვენა-კლიკის მენიუში. მთავარი: შრის შექმნა მონიშნულებიდან — ახალი შრე იმავე პირველწყაროთი (ფაილი არ იქმნება), ინახება პროექტში. მუშაობს GeoPackage, PostGIS, Shapefile და FileGDB-ზე.

plugins.author: GIS GEORGIA | Giorgi Kapanadze

changelog.text: Contact e-mail is now aigroegsig@gmail.com.
Processing algorithms (Toolbox, Model Builder, qgis_process, Python): Make layer from selected features, Definition query from selection, Add auto-increment key.
Wording only: "პლაგინი" is now "დანამატი" in the bundled README, NOTICE and comments.

Runs on QGIS 4 (Qt6) and QGIS 3.40+ (Qt5) from the same build: scoped Qt enums, exec() instead of exec_(), QMetaType instead of QVariant field types, and Qt imported through qgis.PyQt. Minimum QGIS is now 3.40 LTR.

First release. ArcGIS-style Selection submenu; Make Layer From Selected Features on the same source (no file written), saved with the project. Self-verifying key selection: real PK (GeoPackage fid / PostGIS gid / FileGDB OBJECTID) -> unique attribute field -> OGR FID -> $id/"fid", each probe-verified so no empty layer is ever created silently. When a shapefile has no usable key, offers to add an auto-increment field (sel_uid). Bilingual ka/en.

plugins.name: Georgian Cadastre
plugins.summary: Georgian cadastre toolkit for QGIS: fetch parcels by code from the public cadastre service, and prepare full cadastral survey drawings — UTM 37N/38N templates, WMS/WMTS services, name-based styles, Georgian fonts, an A4 layout with dynamic fields, an Excel attachment and a one-click packaged export.

description.en: Fetch cadastral parcels by code from the public cadastre service — single, batch and map-click lookup — and prepare the full survey drawing: UTM 37N/38N templates, WMS/WMTS services, name-based styles, A4 layout, Excel attachment and one-click packaged export.
description.ka: ნაკვეთის ჩამოწერა საკადასტრო კოდით საჯარო საკადასტრო სერვისიდან — ერთი, სია (batch) და რუკიდან — და საკადასტრო აგეგმვითი/აზომვითი ნახაზის სრული მომზადება: UTM 37N/38N შაბლონები, WMS/WMTS სერვისები, სტილები, A4 layout, ექსელის დანართი და ერთ-ღილაკიანი შეფუთული ექსპორტი.

plugins.author: GIS GEORGIA | Giorgi Kapanadze

changelog.text: Contact e-mail is now aigroegsig@gmail.com.
Processing algorithms (Toolbox, Model Builder, qgis_process, Python): "Fetch parcels by cadastral code" (codes from text or a table) and "Fetch parcels near a point".

Clearer fetch errors: when the cadastre service returns an "Access Denied"/HTML page or is down, fetch-by-code and batch now show a plain "service unavailable / try later" message (KA/EN) instead of a confusing "Invalid response". Area/radius search is unaffected. (The service itself has been unreliable lately — this is upstream, not the plugin.)

Runs on QGIS 4 (Qt6) and QGIS 3.40+ (Qt5) from the same build: scoped Qt enums, exec() instead of exec_(), QMetaType instead of QVariant field types, and Qt imported through qgis.PyQt. Minimum QGIS is now 3.40 LTR.
Neutral naming: the data-source brand is no longer shown in the UI (hints, labels, layer names) — the bulk layer is now "cadastre_parcels" and gets the cadastre outline+area style.

Fully merged the cadastre-fetch window into the Fetch-by-code tab: single, batch (list / from file, with progress + cancel) and SHP/DXF/CSV export now live inside the central window — no separate dialog opens anymore.

Area (bulk) download in the fetch tab: grab every parcel within a radius of a cadastral code, or across the current map extent, into a separate parcels layer. Runs as a background task with a live progress bar and pause / resume / cancel — the UI never freezes.

Unified into a single window: cadastre fetch-by-code (and map-click reverse) is now a tab inside the central dialog, dropping parcels straight into the nakveti layer; a 'batch / export' button still opens the full fetch dialog. One toolbar button instead of two.

Added the Cadastral Drawing toolkit (CRS 37/38 templates, WMS/WMTS services, name-based styles, Georgian fonts, A4 layout with dynamic fields, Excel attachment, packaged export) alongside the cadastre fetcher.
Cadastre code→parcel fetch: single & batch, reverse lookup, SHP/DXF/CSV export.

usage.en: Web menu and the Web toolbar button; Processing Toolbox.
usage.ka: მენიუ „ვები“ და ვების პანელის ღილაკი; Processing Toolbox.

plugins.name: PostGIS Manager
plugins.summary: Unique spatial-database GIS toolkit for PostGIS — geometry editor on canvas, CRS audit, spatial join GUI, data-quality scoring, pgRouting network wizard, WFS, GPX import, thematic classification and snapshot diff. Not a pgAdmin clone.

description.en: Spatial-database toolkit for PostGIS: geometry editor, CRS audit, spatial-join GUI, data-quality scoring, pgRouting network wizard, WFS connector and GPX import.
description.ka: სივრცული მონაცემთა ბაზის ხელსაწყოები PostGIS-ისთვის: გეომეტრიის რედაქტორი, CRS აუდიტი, სივრცული შეერთება, მონაცემთა ხარისხის შეფასება, pgRouting ოსტატი, WFS და GPX იმპორტი.

plugins.author: GIS GEORGIA | Giorgi Kapanadze

changelog.text: Contact e-mail is now aigroegsig@gmail.com.

Processing: new algorithms Backup database (pg_dump), Restore database (pg_restore / psql, needs an explicit confirmation) and CRS audit (declared vs. actual SRID, optional fix). Passwords are passed through PGPASSWORD, a saved QGIS login (authentication configuration) can be used instead Backup and CRS Audit panels share their logic with the algorithms (utils/pg_tools.py); the CRS audit SQL now uses quoted identifiers and bound parameters
(2026-09-10) Georgian UI: "ფლაგინი" is now "დანამატი", matching the wording used across GIS GEORGIA's plugins and plugins.qgis.ge

(2026-09-10) Runs on QGIS 3.40+ (Qt5) as well as QGIS 4.x (Qt6), from the same build Qt is now imported through postgis_manager.qtcompat, which resolves qgis.PyQt inside QGIS and falls back to PyQt6/PyQt5 for the standalone app Classes Qt moved between QtWidgets and QtGui (QAction, QShortcut, ...) are exported from both, so imports no longer depend on the Qt version

(2026-06-18) Strategic refocus: unique GIS tools, not a generic pgAdmin clone New: Map Viewer + Geometry Editor (draw geometry into the table) New: CRS Browser & Reproject, CRS Audit (SRID mismatch detection) New: Spatial Join GUI (7 predicates + KNN), no SQL required New: Spatial Data Quality Dashboard (7 checks, 0–100 score, auto-fix) New: pgRouting Network Wizard (topology + drive-time isochrones) New: WFS Connector, GPX/KML Importer, Thematic Style Generator New: Layer Snapshot + spatial Change Diff Removed: generic DB-admin panels that duplicated pgAdmin Fixes: map pan, KeyError on WFS layers, Instance Manager layout
(2026-06-15) First stable release; 21 panels, sidebar navigation QGIS Processing Provider; full EN + KA translations; light/dark themes
(2026-05-01) Initial release targeting QGIS 3.34+ / Qt6

plugins.name: DevBridge
plugins.summary: Live PyQGIS debugging from QGIS: control panel with buttons for the VS Code (debugpy) and PyCharm bridges, one-click "prepare my plugin for debugging", and a bundled standalone desktop tool. Bilingual EN/KA.

description.en: Debug your own PyQGIS plugins live from VS Code or PyCharm. A control panel with buttons (EN/KA): start/stop the debug bridges, pick a plugin from your profile and prepare it (venv, debugpy, VS Code config) — plus a bundled standalone desktop tool that does the same without QGIS running.
description.ka: გამართე შენი PyQGIS დანამატები ცოცხლად VS Code-იდან ან PyCharm-იდან. მართვის პანელი ღილაკებით (EN/KA): დებაგ ხიდების გაშვება/გაჩერება, პროფილიდან დანამატის არჩევა და მომზადება (venv, debugpy, VS Code-ის კონფიგურაცია) — და ჩაშენებული დამოუკიდებელი დესკტოპ ხელსაწყო, რომელიც იგივეს QGIS-ის გაშვების გარეშე აკეთებს.

plugins.author: GIS GEORGIA | Giorgi Kapanadze

changelog.text: Contact e-mail is now aigroegsig@gmail.com.

Bundled desktop tool (tool/devbridge) updated: 'devbridge launch' (VS Code's F5 "Launch QGIS + attach", the desktop tool's "Launch QGIS (debug)") no longer opens a redundant second QGIS when one with the bridge already listening is still open - it reuses it instead ('--force-new' to opt out). No change to the plugin's own code.

Bundled desktop tool (tool/devbridge) updated: new 'devbridge doctor --fix' retries what's safe automatically (plugin install/enable, debugpy, rerunning setup) and re-checks; a "Fix what's safe" button was added next to "Run diagnostics". No change to the plugin's own code.

Bundled desktop tool (tool/devbridge) updated: 'devbridge setup' now also writes PyCharm's "Python Debug Server" run configuration (.idea/runConfigurations/), the last fully-manual PyCharm step. No change to the plugin's own code.

Control Panel tabs now follow the order you actually use them in: "Prepare a plugin" moved before "VS Code" (used to come after PyCharm, contradicting the guide's own numbered steps). "How to use" now opens with a one-line tab roadmap.
Bundled desktop tool (tool/devbridge) updated: new 'devbridge new-script' command scaffolds a starter standalone PyQGIS script ready for headless debugging. No change to the plugin's own code.

Bundled desktop tool (tool/devbridge) updated: 'devbridge setup' now also writes a "PyQGIS: Debug current file (no QGIS)" VS Code launch config, for debugging a standalone script (QgsApplication, no running QGIS) directly. No change to the plugin's own code.

Bundled desktop tool (tool/devbridge) updated: warns when --host isn't local (debugpy/pydevd have no authentication of their own), and 'devbridge setup' now keeps .venv/__pycache__/.pycharm-debug out of git via .gitignore. No change to the plugin's own code.

Bundled desktop tool (tool/devbridge) updated: 'devbridge link-plugin' and 'devbridge uninstall' commands, automatic port-conflict handling in 'setup'/'launch', and an automated GitHub Release workflow for this repo. No change to the plugin's own code.

Bundled desktop tool (tool/devbridge) updated: 'devbridge doctor' (checks QGIS/debugpy/plugin/port/.vscode end to end) and a QGIS-installation picker for machines with several QGIS installs side by side. No change to the plugin's own code.

Built-in "Reload plugin" picker at the top of the Control Panel (visible on every tab): pick a plugin already enabled in this QGIS session and reload its code (qgis.utils.reloadPlugin) without a QGIS restart or the separate Plugin Reloader plugin.

Critical fix: the VS Code debug bridge never told debugpy which Python to use, so debugpy.listen() tried to launch its adapter through the QGIS program itself and failed after ~20-30s with "timed out waiting for adapter to connect" - confirmed with a real QGIS 3.44.5, every time. debugpy is now configured with the interpreter QGIS embeds before listen(); also treats a second listen() (plugin reload) as already-running instead of raising.

PyCharm: pydevd-pycharm is now installed into DevBridge's own folder with QGIS's real Python (it used to call the QGIS program itself), in a background thread with a live log; refuses to connect unless PyCharm is listening (a failed connect could crash QGIS); one debugger per QGIS session (VS Code or PyCharm) with a clear message. New "How to use" tab with step-by-step instructions (EN/KA), also in the desktop tool. "Prepare a plugin" now starts with a choice: improve an existing plugin (list over every QGIS profile, nothing pre-selected), start a NEW plugin (writes working starter files) or any folder.

Control Panel with tabs for VS Code, PyCharm, plugin preparation and the desktop tool; language switch EN/KA; standalone desktop tool bundled in the plugin (tool/), launchable from the panel; shared settings file; universal build for QGIS 3.40+ (Qt5) and QGIS 4 (Qt6).
First version: debugpy bridge menu and PyCharm auto-configuration.

plugins.author: GIS GEORGIA | Giorgi Kapanadze

changelog.text: Contact e-mail is now aigroegsig@gmail.com.
Wording only: "პლაგინი/ფლაგინი" is now "დანამატი" in the bundled comments and docs.

Runs on QGIS 4 (Qt6) and QGIS 3.40+ (Qt5) from the same build: scoped Qt enums, exec() instead of exec_(), QMetaType instead of QVariant field types, and Qt imported through qgis.PyQt. Minimum QGIS is now 3.40 LTR.

Fix: no longer shadows QGIS's built-in Processing plugin. The bundled dir is now appended to sys.path (was inserted at 0), so the geoeco/processing/ subpackage stops breaking `import processing` at QGIS startup.

plugins.author: GIS GEORGIA | Giorgi Kapanadze

changelog.text: Full standalone program (python app.py): photo table, GPX / CSV / fixed coordinates, clock-offset estimate, preview, place names (OpenStreetMap or GeoJSON/GPKG/SHP polygons), map with OpenStreetMap tiles to pick coordinates and move points, export, undo, settings, warning notice, Georgian/English.
Contact e-mail is now aigroegsig@gmail.com.

Warning notice (legal, accuracy, privacy, backups, signatures, OSM licence): banner and full notice in the dialog, acknowledged once before the first write; shown in Processing help and with --notice.

Place names (country, region, city, street) written into photos as XMP (and IPTC with ExifTool): from OpenStreetMap Nominatim or from a polygon/point layer; dialog group, --place-names, two Processing algorithms; place names are included in the point layer and exports.
Processing algorithms (Toolbox, Model Builder, qgis_process): Photos to points, Geotag from GPX / CSV / point layer, Restore originals, Estimate clock offset.
ExifTool engine verified against ExifTool 13.59 (Georgian file names, backups, restore, TIFF, --out copies, RAW read fallback); it is now used automatically when found, otherwise the built-in writer.

Layer to photos: move points in a layer and write the new coordinates back into the photos. Restore originals (undo) from the _original backups. Optional ExifTool engine (off by default: Writing engine setting / --engine) with RAW/HEIC embedding.
GPL-3.0-or-later LICENSE and README added; package checked against plugins.qgis.org upload rules.

Preview table before writing; clock-offset estimate from one photo of known position; existing coordinates are kept unless Overwrite is ticked; direction (GPSImgDirection) with arrow symbol and photo map tip on the layer; work runs as a background task with progress and Cancel; --dry-run in the script; large RAW files are read through mmap; unit tests.

Camera formats: JPEG, TIFF, DNG written directly; RAW (NEF, CR2, CR3, ARW, ORF, RW2, RAF ...) and HEIC via XMP sidecar. Output: project layer and GPKG, Shapefile, GeoJSON, CSV, KML, GPX, FlatGeobuf, GML, MapInfo, SpatiaLite files.
First release.
